cause_quote: The guard `if (!trimmed && !params.installedSkillSearch)` allowed the section to render with an empty directory when search was enabled, but every read branch still began with `Scan <available_skills>.`
user_saw: Users could get responses from an agent that skipped a relevant installed skill after being told to scan a directory missing from its prompt.
summary: The fix tells agents when to search for installed skills if the prompt omits the directory and explains how to read a skill by its known name in direct-tool and Code Mode sessions.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff, which shows that the previous prompt builder returned early when the directory was empty. The same commit introduced installed-skill search in that state and shipped the misleading scan instruction, so the defect was present from the start. The fix's test diff covers the empty-directory case in both tool modes.
